company.name: monte
company.shortDescription: Monte develops and builds buses and provides vehicle sales, repair, and technical installation services.
company.description: Monte develops and builds buses, including vehicles intended for school transport. The company sells new and used buses, supplies spare parts, and operates a repair workshop with after-sales service. Its maintenance activities include mechanical, bodywork, air-conditioning, heating, electrical fault diagnosis, windscreen, and side-glass replacement. Monte also installs tachographs and speed limiters and provides central heating, climate-control, gas, sanitary, and electrotechnical services.
